name: subagents
description: Bots hand work to subagents that run in the background, and report back together. The bot's panel lists them, each with its thread.

settings.name: atOnce
settings.description: The most subagents a bot has working at one time, 1 to 10

settings.name: perAsk
settings.description: The most subagents one request from you leads to, 1 to 50

settings.name: minutes
settings.description: The most minutes one subagent works, 1 to 240

settings.name: calls
settings.description: The most tool calls one subagent makes, 1 to 1000

settings.name: handOff
settings.description: on: your bot hands work that takes a lot of digging to subagents, and tells you it'll come back with the results. off: it starts one only when it decides to

settings.name: thinking
settings.description: How hard subagents think: same, the bot's own level, or a level such as low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. A level the bot's model doesn't offer runs as the nearest lower one

settings.name: keepDays
settings.description: How many days an ended subagent is kept, 1 to 90

settings.name: blocked
settings.description: Tools a subagent can't call, comma-separated: its chat does these
settings.default: memory_save, memory_forget, messages_send, routines_add, routines_change, routines_remove, computer_ask_owner
